production_rule: No candidate is production-authorized by this registry. Source -> legal/provenance -> local intake/hash -> Godot import -> fixed-view 2m/5m/8m photo-match -> performance -> owner GARDER is required.

license_policy.noai_note: A NoAI flag does not block normal game use when the declared content license allows it, but the asset must never be used to train or improve AI/ML systems.
license_policy.public_repo_rule: Paid/proprietary raw assets must not be committed to the public repository unless the license explicitly allows redistribution. Keep them in a private/external intake pipeline and ship only as permitted by their license.

animation_sources.notes: Use for biped idle/walk/run/turn/gesture retargeting. Do not use Mixamo content to train/test/improve AI/ML. Preserve any distribution restrictions from Adobe terms; do not assume raw-library redistribution rights.
